# HL7v2 v3.10.1 - Table of Contents

Pure Elixir HL7 v2.x toolkit — schema-driven parsing, typed segments, message builder, MLLP transport

## Modules

- [HL7v2.Access](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Access.md): Path-based access to HL7v2 message fields.
- [HL7v2.Conformance.Fixtures](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Conformance.Fixtures.md): Conformance fixture corpus statistics.
- [HL7v2.MessageDefinition](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.MessageDefinition.md): Canonical message structure mappings and validation dispatch.
- [HL7v2.Path](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Path.md): Represents a validated HL7v2 path.
- [HL7v2.Profile](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Profile.md): Conformance profile for constraining HL7v2 message structures beyond
the base HL7 spec.
- [HL7v2.Profile.ComponentAccess](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Profile.ComponentAccess.md): Positional component access for HL7 composite data type structs.
- [HL7v2.Profiles.Examples](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Profiles.Examples.md): Example conformance profiles demonstrating common integrator patterns.
- [HL7v2.Profiles.IHE](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Profiles.IHE.md): Pre-built IHE conformance profiles for HL7 v2.x transactions.
- [HL7v2.Profiles.IHE.Common](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Profiles.IHE.Common.md): Shared constraint helpers for the IHE profile pack.
- [HL7v2.Profiles.IHE.LTW](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Profiles.IHE.LTW.md): IHE Laboratory Testing Workflow (LTW) conformance profiles.
- [HL7v2.Profiles.IHE.PAM](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Profiles.IHE.PAM.md): IHE Patient Administration Management (PAM) conformance profiles.
- [HL7v2.Profiles.IHE.PDQ](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Profiles.IHE.PDQ.md): IHE Patient Demographics Query (PDQ) conformance profiles.
- [HL7v2.Profiles.IHE.PIX](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Profiles.IHE.PIX.md): IHE Patient Identifier Cross-Reference (PIX) conformance profiles.
- [HL7v2.Profiles.IHE.RadSwf](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Profiles.IHE.RadSwf.md): IHE Radiology Scheduled Workflow (RAD-SWF) conformance profiles.
- [HL7v2.Segment](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Segment.md): Base behaviour and helpers for typed HL7v2 segments.
- [HL7v2.Sigil](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Sigil.md): Compile-time validated HL7v2 path sigil.
- [HL7v2.Standard](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Standard.md): HL7 v2.5.1 standard metadata — single source of truth.
- [HL7v2.Standard.Coverage](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Standard.Coverage.md): Computes library coverage against the HL7 v2.5.1 standard.
- [HL7v2.Standard.MessageStructure](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Standard.MessageStructure.md): HL7 v2.5.1 abstract message structure definitions.
- [HL7v2.Standard.Tables](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Standard.Tables.md): HL7 v2.5.1 coded-value tables.
- [HL7v2.Standard.Version](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Standard.Version.md): HL7 v2.x version utilities.
- [HL7v2.Standard.VersionDeltas](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Standard.VersionDeltas.md): Tracks field optionality changes between HL7 v2.x versions.
- [HL7v2.Type](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Type.md): Base behaviour for HL7v2 data types.

- Core
  - [HL7v2](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.md): Pure Elixir HL7 v2.x toolkit.
  - [HL7v2.Encoder](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Encoder.md): Serializes HL7v2 messages to wire format.
  - [HL7v2.Escape](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Escape.md): Encodes and decodes HL7v2 escape sequences.
  - [HL7v2.Parser](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Parser.md): Parses HL7v2 messages into raw representation with canonical round-trip fidelity.
  - [HL7v2.RawMessage](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.RawMessage.md): Represents a parsed HL7v2 message in raw form.
  - [HL7v2.Separator](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Separator.md): Detects and manages HL7v2 message delimiters from MSH-1/MSH-2.

- Typed Messages
  - [HL7v2.Ack](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Ack.md): Builds HL7v2 ACK/NAK response messages.
  - [HL7v2.Message](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Message.md): Programmatic HL7v2 message construction.
  - [HL7v2.TypedMessage](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.TypedMessage.md): Typed HL7v2 message with parsed segment structs.
  - [HL7v2.TypedParser](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.TypedParser.md): Converts a raw-parsed HL7v2 message into typed segment structs.

  - [HL7v2.Type.TQ](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Type.TQ.md): Timing/Quantity (TQ) -- HL7v2 composite data type.
  - [HL7v2.Type.TS](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Type.TS.md): Time Stamp (TS) -- HL7v2 composite data type.
  - [HL7v2.Type.TX](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Type.TX.md): Text Data (TX) -- HL7v2 primitive data type.
  - [HL7v2.Type.UVC](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Type.UVC.md): UB Value Code and Amount (UVC) -- HL7v2 composite data type.
  - [HL7v2.Type.VH](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Type.VH.md): Visiting Hours (VH) -- HL7v2 composite data type.
  - [HL7v2.Type.VID](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Type.VID.md): Version Identifier (VID) -- HL7v2 composite data type.
  - [HL7v2.Type.VR](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Type.VR.md): Value Range (VR) -- HL7v2 composite data type.
  - [HL7v2.Type.WVI](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Type.WVI.md): Channel Identifier (WVI) -- HL7v2 composite data type.
  - [HL7v2.Type.WVS](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Type.WVS.md): Waveform Source (WVS) -- HL7v2 composite data type.
  - [HL7v2.Type.XAD](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Type.XAD.md): Extended Address (XAD) -- HL7v2 composite data type.
  - [HL7v2.Type.XCN](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Type.XCN.md): Extended Composite ID Number and Name for Persons (XCN) -- HL7v2 composite data type.
  - [HL7v2.Type.XON](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Type.XON.md): Extended Composite Name and ID for Organizations (XON) -- HL7v2 composite data type.
  - [HL7v2.Type.XPN](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Type.XPN.md): Extended Person Name (XPN) -- HL7v2 composite data type.
  - [HL7v2.Type.XTN](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Type.XTN.md): Extended Telecommunication Number (XTN) -- HL7v2 composite data type.

- Validation
  - [HL7v2.Validation](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Validation.md): Validates HL7v2 typed messages.
  - [HL7v2.Validation.FieldRules](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Validation.FieldRules.md): Field-level validation rules for HL7v2 typed segments.
  - [HL7v2.Validation.MessageRules](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Validation.MessageRules.md): Message-level validation rules for HL7v2 typed messages.
  - [HL7v2.Validation.ProfileRules](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Validation.ProfileRules.md): Evaluates a `HL7v2.Profile` against a typed message and returns validation
errors. Called from `HL7v2.Validation.validate/2` when a `:profile` option
is provided.
  - [HL7v2.Validation.Structural](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Validation.Structural.md): Positional structural validation against HL7 v2.5.1 abstract message definitions.

- MLLP Transport
  - [HL7v2.MLLP](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.MLLP.md): MLLP (Minimal Lower Layer Protocol) framing for HL7v2 messages.
  - [HL7v2.MLLP.Client](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.MLLP.Client.md): MLLP TCP client for sending HL7v2 messages.
  - [HL7v2.MLLP.Connection](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.MLLP.Connection.md): Ranch protocol handler for MLLP connections.
  - [HL7v2.MLLP.Handler](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.MLLP.Handler.md): Behaviour for MLLP message handlers.
  - [HL7v2.MLLP.Listener](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.MLLP.Listener.md): MLLP TCP listener using Ranch 2.x.
  - [HL7v2.MLLP.TLS](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.MLLP.TLS.md): TLS configuration helpers for MLLP connections.

- Telemetry
  - [HL7v2.Telemetry](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/HL7v2.Telemetry.md): Telemetry event helpers for HL7v2 operations.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix hl7v2.coverage](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Hl7v2.Coverage.md): Prints HL7 v2.5.1 coverage report for the hl7v2 library.
- [mix hl7v2.gen_docs](https://hl7v2.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Hl7v2.GenDocs.md): Generates reference documentation from code metadata.
